cells.remarks: Fragmentary. Seems to mention a gift for the merit of the king. The name of Gaṇḍama-nāyaka, Prātama-nāyaka, Prōlaya-nāyaka of Dhārāpura and some seṭṭis like Prōli-seṭṭi etc., are mentioned. As witness to the gift are mentioned Sōmarāju, the minister (pradhāni) of Gōvinda-mahādēva and certain Īśvara-nāyaka. In characters of the 13th century.

cells.location: KANKER TAHSIL
cells.place: Kanker.—Verandah of the school building.
cells.remarks: Traces the genealogies of the king and his minister Nāyaka Vāsudēva and records constructions of two temples of Mahādēva and Kshētrēśa and the excavation of two tanks one of them called Kaṇḍuka by the latter. States that the record was composed by Śakti Kumāra. Published in Ep. Ind., Vol. IX, pp. 123 ff.

cells.place: Kharōd.—Slab built into the wall on the left side of the maṇḍapa, Lakshmaṇēśvara temple. Impression from the Superintendent, South-Eastern Circle, Visakhapatnam.
